author: Leonid Popryho
method: Own router (method not disclosed), one unified fast configuration for every case: the time budget and the component switches are chosen from the instance itself, never from the tier or case name. Deterministic (fixed work budget).
hardware: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9975WX (32 cores / 64 threads), 256 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (one GPU, used on dense grids)
runtime_note: runtime.json: wall-clock seconds of the router run (with its GPU step where used), measured on an idle machine, one case at a time; the JSON / text format conversions (tens of milliseconds) are not included
reproducibility: deterministic: every route regenerates bit for bit from a recorded run manifest (instance, arguments, seed, binary hash); replayed 45/45 identical, GPU and CPU builds giving the same routes. The code is not published at this time.
